scope: Recursive deterministic checked-in MIME seeding for both manual fuzz targets. No fuzz campaign or full-source result is established here.

checks.command: bash -n scripts/run-mail-safety-fuzz.sh; node --check on all three MJS files
Independent actual-corpus seeding in two fresh private roots
checks.result: 75 unique raw fixtures in both targets; all 48 nested obsolete fixtures included; all source/copy byte lengths and hashes independently verified; repeated manifests and corpora identical; printed manifest SHA matched actual file

sensitivity: Restricting traversal to the top directory fails the nested seed count and source-path assertions.
Using basename alone fails the collision or exclusive-write oracle.
Changing manifest byte counts or hashes fails independent source-byte recomputation.
Changing printed digest fails actual CLI-to-file comparison.
limits: The runner provides a fresh private mktemp output root and trusted checked-in source. It is not a hardened general-purpose copy utility for adversarial concurrent filesystems.
The manifest includes an absolute source path, so its digest identifies the exact run environment rather than a portable cross-worktree corpus.
Deep-lane fuzzing must still run after final source freeze.
